## Problem

What are you trying to do that Seiva makes hard or impossible today?

## Proposed solution

What you would like to see. If it introduces or changes an architectural
pattern, boundary or public contract, note that — those land as an
[ADR](../../docs/adr/) first.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you weighed, and why this one.

## Additional context

Links, prior art (how axum/actix/Poem/Loco/Django/FastAPI handle it), examples.
